text: M15 L17 (`m6ukdbsc`) asks the Writing style select to badge options so that every `source` value is told apart (not two), and `ac-styl-user-authored-pojawia-sie-w-dropdow` asks for the `user` style badged by its source distinctly from the others — but no literal badge text is given.
